title: Explore Bonneville Salt Flats Journey to the Edge of the World
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the otherworldly Bonneville Salt Flats—where endless white horizons meet history, adventure, and stunning panoramas. More than just sightseeing, our tour offers the most comprehensive experience of this natural wonder, revealing hidden stories and remarkable landmarks.

From the legendary Bonneville Speedway, where land speed records continue to be set today, to the iconic 85-foot Tree of Utah sculpture rising from the desert, every stop inspires awe.

Explore the mysterious Blue Canal that once helped protect Salt Lake City from devastating floods, enjoy sweeping views from the Silver Island Mountains, and drive alongside the legendary Great Salt Lake, taking in breathtaking panoramas of one of North America's most remarkable natural landscapes.

With small-group travel in a comfortable Mercedes Sprinter, a professional guide, and hotel pickup and drop-off included, this tour blends adventure, relaxation, and storytelling into an unforgettable experience.
